Convert line art into the person in the reference image (face contour, eye shape and size, nose shape, lip thickness, hairstyle and hair color, body type), thoroughly eliminate the following AI-specific unnaturalness: - Do not make the skin perfectly uniform. Add pores (tiny but present), a very thin sheen of sebum, and a fine texture where vellus hairs are translucent in the light. - Hair should not be perfectly neat strand by strand. Include stray hairs, strands of hair disheveled by wind or movement, and fine hairs that are translucent in the light. - Do not fill the iris with a solid color. Include a gradient with warm colors around the pupil and slightly cool colors around the outer edge, and the fiber pattern of the iris (radial lines). - Catchlights should be shaped to match the ambient light source (a thin line for fluorescent light, a rectangle for window light, and an irregular white dot for outdoor light). Avoid perfectly round white spots.

<Shooting Style>: Photographs taken with a real camera - Equipment: Modern full-frame mirrorless camera (Sony α7IV / Canon EOS R6 equivalent) - Lens: Medium telephoto 85mm F1.8, shot at wide open to F2.8 - Depth of Field: Just in focus on the subject's face, slightly soft on the shoulders to chest, natural bokeh in the background (circular to lemon-shaped bokeh) - ISO 200-400 equivalent: Almost noiseless, but not completely noise-free (extremely fine color noise in dark areas) - White Balance: Natural color temperature matched to ambient light (slightly cool under fluorescent lights, slightly warm in the evening)
